command: set -u; echo ID=$(hostname):$(id -un); echo VM=$(systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p MainPID -p ActiveEnterTimestamp --value | tr '\n' '|'); for p in /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/agentzero/consciousness.db /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/agentzero/unified.db /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/frank/db/amygdala.db /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/frank/db/world_experience.db /var/lib/entityos/data/unified.db; do echo DB=$p; sudo -n stat -c 'STAT=%s|%y' "$p"; x=$(sudo -n lsof -t -- "$p" 2>/dev/null | sort -un | paste -sd, -); echo OPEN_PIDS=${x:-none}; done; echo ROWS; q(){ p=$1; t=$2; if sudo -n sqlite3 "file:$p?mode=ro" "SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='$t';" 2>/dev/null | grep -q 1; then n=$(sudo -n sqlite3 "file:$p?mode=ro" "SELECT count(*) FROM \"$t\";" 2>/dev/null); echo "$p|$t|$n"; else echo "$p|$t|ABSENT"; fi; }; q /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/agentzero/consciousness.db reflections; q /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/agentzero/consciousness.db consciousness_events; q /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/agentzero/unified.db dopamine_state; q /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/agentzero/unified.db reward_log; q /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/frank/db/world_experience.db personality_state; q /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/frank/db/world_experience.db identity_snapshot; q /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/frank/db/world_experience.db identity_snapshots; echo DURABLE_MATCHES; sudo -n sqlite3 'file:/var/lib/entityos/data/unified.db?mode=ro' "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND (lower(name) GLOB '*conscious*' OR lower(name) GLOB '*person*' OR lower(name) GLOB '*identity*' OR lower(name) GLOB '*experience*' OR lower(name) GLOB '*amyg*' OR lower(name) GLOB '*dopamine*' OR lower(name) GLOB '*reward*') ORDER BY name;" 2>/dev/null; echo VOICE_PATHS; sudo -n grep -R -n -E 'consciousness\.db|world_experience\.db|amygdala\.db|agentzero/unified\.db|expanduser\(.*agentzero' /var/lib/entityos/voice --include='*.py' --exclude-dir=venv --exclude-dir=__pycache__ 2>/dev/null | head -80
